run_ensemble_predictions_cli: run the ensemble predictions CLI tool with data root, split, predictions path, and output path flags
build_ensemble_predictions: build ensembled predictions by averaging softmax probabilities and mode voting across k-fold model logits
load_predictions_from_disk: load k-fold model predictions from dill files organized by model index and date subdirectories
generate_ensembled_predictions: generate ensembled predictions by loading data arrays, loading model predictions, and ensembling them together
evaluate_validation_predictions: evaluate validation predictions using the MAG240M evaluator and log the accuracy output
